_note: In-memory fixes to Synty meshes (SyntyFixes, D-043); the shared pack is never written. hide_meshes: extracted mesh resources whose surfaces are cleared at boot, so every prefab using them draws nothing for that part.
_why_vending_signs: SM_Prop_Vending_Machine_02 carries two ad-sign rings drawn with Glass_01_mat over the atlas: in the pack demo they spin, here they stand still and read as a red dotted FX ring floating over the machine (greenhouse prefab, colony street dressing).
